inputs.source: Same fixed64_offset_trusted random corpus exported by the C++ codec benchmark
inputs.wire_size_formula: 8-byte standard SBE header + 56-byte fixed block + 4-byte varData length + payload

valid_outputs.correctness: All corpus records validated against independent checksums; validated decoder also rejects short header, incorrect schema, and incorrect payload-length smoke cases

measurement.calibration: Double the operation count until the target duration or the cap; execute and time the cap itself; return the actual last timed count
measurement.reported_statistics: Median/minimum/maximum of five batch mean ns/op values, not per-message latency percentiles
measurement.decode_all: All scalar fields plus payload length and first/last payload bytes; not a complete payload scan
measurement.decode_few: id + seq + type; validated mode additionally verifies frame metadata and payload bounds
measurement.encode: Generated field setters plus putPayload copy into a reused output string
measurement.observability: Checksums consumed, output escaped via compiler memory barrier, encode/decode entrypoints noinline
measurement.virtual_dispatch_caveat: A single concrete codec in this supplementary executable may permit compiler devirtualization; tiny differences from other executables are not format guarantees

validation_modes.sbe_generated_validated: Generated bounds checks enabled plus application wrapper checks for minimum length, schema/template/version, root block length and exact payload bounds; benchmark schema v1 only
validation_modes.sbe_generated_trusted: Compiled with SBE_NO_BOUNDS_CHECK; no application frame validation; valid/prevalidated wires required

isolation.valid_run_sequence: After transport measurements and the clean Java/Flink rerun had completed and explicitly released the CPU

cgroup.throttling_conclusion: unknown; no before/after cgroup snapshot was captured for this SBE run

initial_run_exclusion.reason: The original adaptive timer incremented count after timing 8388608 operations and could exit at 16777216 without executing that count, then divide the previous elapsed time by the doubled count
initial_run_exclusion.impact: Fast cells reaching that guard could report half the correct ns/op
initial_run_exclusion.action: Quarantined the entire first SBE run and reran all 160 raw rows after fixing the timer; final results contain only the corrected rerun
initial_run_exclusion.related_cpp_codec_data: The codec benchmark owner inspected all 1780 existing codec/flat_direct/compression/compression_reuse raw rows and found no iterations>=2^24, so their existing raw data did not trigger this boundary bug; its source timer was separately corrected

scope_limits: Pure CPU/memory codec microbenchmark; no real NIC, DPDK, DMA, kernel socket or network path is measured
No JVM or Flink processing is part of these SBE timing rows
Hot reusable corpus and buffer capacities; not allocation pressure, cold-cache, NUMA or contention testing
No live schema rollout or general hostile-input fuzzing
Do not describe results as zero nanoseconds, end-to-end latency or production message-rate capacity
